subject: botany
question_text: Mention the fern characters found in Cycas.

verification.note: Sourced from the Sri Chaitanya Junior Fastrack botany section, Chapter 4 Plant Kingdom, book p.7, VSAQ 6. The book lists four characters: multiciliate male gametes, circinate vernation, ramenta, archegonia — the standard set. Only one source book is held for botany — the TSBIE Basic Learning Material in hand is physics-only and no botany board paper is in the corpus — so the two-book union check and the back-test are both structurally impossible for this card, not merely unrun. The mark split is a claim until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms it.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Leaf characters
lines: Circinate vernation — the young leaf is
coiled and uncoils as it grows.
Ramenta — brown scaly hairs on the young
steps.why: These two vegetative characters are exactly what a fern leaf shows, so their presence in Cycas — a gymnosperm — is called its fern character.
common_mistakes: Writing 'reticulate venation' for 'circinate vernation' — vernation is how the young leaf is rolled, not the vein pattern.
steps.memory_tip: Circinate comes from 'circle' — picture the coiled young fern leaf and the same coil on Cycas.
steps.margin_note: Any two correct characters usually earn full marks; four is the safe list.

steps.label: Reproductive characters
lines: Both are typical of ferns and are also
steps.why: Cycas keeps two fern-like reproductive features: its male gametes swim with many cilia, and its ovule carries archegonia.
common_mistakes: Writing 'antheridia' — Cycas has archegonia but no antheridia.
Writing 'biciliate' — the male gametes of Cycas are multiciliate.
steps.memory_tip: Recall the answer as 2 + 2: two leaf points (vernation, ramenta) and two reproductive points (male gametes, archegonia).
steps.margin_note: Name the characters as short phrases; no explanation is expected.

insider_note: Cycas questions repeat across chapters — the same four fern characters also serve the 'living fossil' discussions, so learn the list once.
